# camundacluster_authorization (Data Source)

Looks up a Camunda cluster authorization by its key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "camundacluster_authorization" "example" {
  id = "2251799813685249"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique key of the authorization to look up (string-encoded int64).

### Read-Only

- `owner_id` (String) The ID of the owner of permissions.
- `owner_type` (String) The type of the owner of permissions (USER, CLIENT, ROLE, GROUP, MAPPING_RULE, or UNSPECIFIED).
- `permission_types` (Set of String) The permission types granted by the authorization.
- `resource_id` (String) The ID of the resource the permission relates to ("*" matches all resources). Null for a property-based authorization.
- `resource_property_name` (String) The name of the resource property the permission relates to. Null for an ID-based authorization.
- `resource_type` (String) The type of resource that the permissions relate to.
